title: host
description: `cpa host name --json` (docs/23 §4.2, D10): this Mac's name, null when it has none (the default). Reading prints it; setting (`cpa host name --json -- 公司`) or clearing (`--clear`) prints the name after. It is config.json's host_label: 1-24 UTF-8 bytes, never starting with '-', no character display_safe() strips; shown on the device and stamped on new recordings. A refused name is the error document: E_BAD_ARG, field name, exit 2.
